Package index

Denoising

Remove physiological noise from fMRI time series.

fast_phy_denoise()
Fast design-free physiological denoising (PHYCAA+-style)
compcor_denoise()
CompCor denoising (aCompCor / tCompCor)

Tissue weights and components

The building blocks of fast_phy_denoise(): neuronal-tissue weights and lag-1 canonical autocorrelation components.

compute_wNN_diff_energy()
Neuronal-tissue weights from temporal-difference energy
extract_caa_oneshot()
One-shot canonical autocorrelation analysis (CAA)

Quality control and benchmarking

Summarise what denoising changed, save the summary, and time the pipeline against simulated ground truth.

compute_design_free_qc()
Compute design-free QC metrics
write_qc_artifact()
Write a QC summary to disk
benchmark_fast_phy_denoise()
Benchmark fast_phy_denoise on simulated data

Simulation

Simulated BOLD data with known physiological and neural sources.

simulate_phy_data()
Simulate BOLD fMRI data with known physiological noise
